ideas.pitch: A real-time 3D digital twin of the UM-Dearborn campus built for the web, highlighting live energy anomalies and foot traffic hot spots using anomaly detection algorithms.
ideas.title: ConjureCampus Dearborn
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven formula of CampusPulse by utilizing machine learning for anomaly detection paired with an interactive 3D environment, appealing to judges looking for practical utility in local infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A continuous generative video world model simulating future traffic scenarios on Michigan Avenue in Dearborn, pivoting mid-stream based on live audience inputs and simulated weather events.
ideas.title: MotorCity World Model
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly channels the cutting-edge generative video and world model patterns seen in the convergence project, offering an impressive visual live demo within the 30-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An immersive web-based augmented reality experience overlaying historical archives and architectural blueprints onto current physical landmarks around Dearborn for mobile browsers.
ideas.title: DearbornAR Heritage Explorer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the theme of 'Conjure Reality' by blending physical location data with digital reconstruction, capitalizing on the high visual impact that traditionally wins spatial computing tracks.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative 3D virtual showroom tailored for the automotive hub of Dearborn, allowing users to customize and inspect 3D vehicle avatars and virtual parts in a shared multiplayer space.
ideas.title: AutoMetaverse Dearborn Showroom
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the web3 metaverse homebase concept to the local automotive industry culture, focusing on an engaging interactive environment and a bulletproof live multi-client demo.

ideas.pitch: A spatial data-engineering dashboard processing regional power consumption logs to dynamically simulate brownouts and optimize energy distribution across municipal sectors.
ideas.title: EcoSim Dearborn Grid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the data-heavy backend approach of the Arctic Challenge winner, proving serious technical competence through complex data processing and clean spatial visualization.
